'''F.C. Fiorentino''' is a [[San Marino|Sanmarinese]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club, based in [[Fiorentino]]. The club was founded in [[1974 in association football|1974]]. Fiorentino currently plays in ''Girone A'' of [[Campionato Sammarinese di Calcio]]. The team's colors are blue and red.
Until the 2004–05 season the club was known as '''S.S. Montevito'''."}}
